description: Source adjudication of 36 sampled TestGuard findings on pinned public repositories: six rows per actual file language. Nothing here estimates population precision or recall.

provenance.reviewer: Premium advisor consultation (independent agent adjudication, not blind human ground truth)
provenance.adjudication_basis: Retained pinned source plus the actual *.before.json and *.final.json reports; no upstream code, script, dependency or mutation tool executed.
provenance.sampling: Purposive, not random. Strata were language, repository, rule and lane; within a stratum the first matching finding in original report order was taken; Gin contributed both removed findings; React selection was restricted to final-minus-baseline .js rows. Selection used report messages, then source and partners were read before comparing first-wave verdicts. Report identity was repository-relative path, line, rule and message.
provenance.limitations: Rows are tuning regressions and narrative evidence, not a held-out probability sample. Do not compute population precision, recall or a confidence interval from these 36 rows.

rows.finding_message: Test 'TestContextInitQueryCache' verifies multi-return call 'validURL' only for non-nil existence without payload assertion
rows.recommendation: Preserve the binding-identity correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: The parsed URL is passed as input to initQueryCache, and the resulting query map is compared with expected keys and values (corroborating lines 902-910). The returned value is therefore used as a payload, not merely checked for existence.

rows.finding_message: Test 'TestOnlyFilesFS_Open' verifies multi-return call 'file' only for non-nil existence without payload assertion
rows.recommendation: Preserve the binding-identity correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: The returned file is type-asserted and its embedded file is compared with the expected object (corroborating lines 32-33).

rows.finding_message: Swallowed error in 'TestThinkValueTransportTypes': error 'err' is checked with a bare return instead of failing the test.
rows.mechanism_note: preceding fatal guard dominates the path
rows.recommendation: Qualify swallowed-error findings by the error binding and dominating guard: suppress this guarded expected-error branch.
rows.oracle_evidence: The immediately preceding fatal guard (lines 1043-1051) checks error presence against the row expected validity. Only an expected error can reach the bare return.

rows.finding_message:
Duplicate table test row in 'TestNoCloud': row {name:         "no config file",
	wantDisabled: false,
	wantSource:   "none",} is duplicated.
rows.recommendation: Keep the duplicate table-row finding.
rows.oracle_evidence: The rows "neither env nor config" and "no config file" supply the same inputs and expect the same outputs (partner at line 371; corroborating lines 414-435). The differing name labels the subtest, not the system under test.

rows.finding_message: Unchecked want field in 'TestFromChatRequest_TopLogprobsRange': field 'expectValid' is declared in table row but never read in the test loop.
rows.recommendation: Keep the finding, but describe it as dead table data. Recommend removing the unused expectValid column or adding meaningful invalid cases; do not claim the rows lack an oracle.
rows.oracle_evidence: expectValid is declared in the table and never read in the loop (lines 1376-1402). All four rows expect success, and the loop does check the actual result.

rows.finding_message: Test 'TestPartialRead' verifies multi-return call 'hdr' only for non-nil existence without payload assertion
rows.mechanism_note: mechanism present but no demonstrated need
rows.recommendation: Keep as informational; do not treat the header-presence check as an actionable defect.
rows.oracle_evidence: The header is only checked for presence, but partial reads (the named behavior) are checked byte-for-byte against tc.output (lines 751-759). No evidence the test needs a header-field assertion.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'trivial'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Keep as informational; do not classify a nested automated-test fixture as a proven zero-assertion defect.
rows.oracle_evidence: The callback is empty, but the file is a nested automated-test fixture. An empty test is consistent with testing discovery; the consuming runner contract for this particular file was not established.

rows.finding_message: Tautological assertion in 'test smoke test -- this test should pass': assertion will always pass vacuously.
rows.recommendation: Keep the lexical signature but avoid presenting the fixture as a defect; it is a harness control.
rows.oracle_evidence: expect(true, isTrue) is vacuous by design (lines 7-12). The file explicitly identifies itself as a control for testing the test harness.

rows.finding_message: Tautological assertion in 'supports value comparisons': assertion will always pass vacuously.
rows.recommendation: Keep the tautology finding; the assertion does not test the advertised value equality.
rows.oracle_evidence: Comparing mockItem with itself (lines 6-15) does not establish the advertised value equality of separately constructed items.

rows.finding_message: Duplicate BLoC scenario: 'emits [unauthenticated] when status is unauthenticated' has identical build/setUp/seed/act/expect to 'emits [unauthenticated] when status is unauthenticated' (line 43).
rows.recommendation: Keep the duplicate-scenario finding.
rows.oracle_evidence: Same enclosing group, mocked status, builder, dispatched event and expected state as the partner at line 43 (corroborating lines 40-53 and 81-91). Not merely two similarly shaped tests.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'should do nothing when no subscription and not throw exception'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Distinguish a no-throw contract from an empty test; do not report it as a blocker.
rows.oracle_evidence: The stated contract is that ngOnDestroy() without a subscription does not throw (lines 110-113). An uncaught exception already fails this test.

rows.finding_message: Structural repetition: 'should return the relative path from the picked file content uri in SD card root' shares normalized token structure with 3 other tests in this file (first seen at 'should return the relative path from the picked file content uri', line 52). Note: structural similarity does not prove semantic redundancy.
rows.recommendation: Keep as informational; do not convert structural resemblance into a deletion recommendation.
rows.oracle_evidence: Similar structure over different storage boundaries: a nested primary-storage path versus an SD-card root, with distinct expected paths (partner at line 52; corroborating lines 54-61 and 91-97). No redundancy established.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'should error if a non-serializable value is passed to a host component'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Consult unambiguous local helper/component evidence before claiming no verification; do not emit a blocker for this shape.
rows.oracle_evidence: The test renders an ErrorBoundary with an expected message (corroborating lines 133-150 and 1362-1378). Its lifecycle checks the caught error, message and digest. No inline matcher in the callback does not mean no outcome verification.

rows.finding_message: Focused test: 'it.only(' silently stops the rest of the file or test suite from running.
rows.recommendation: Report the .only token but do not promise suite-wide exclusion when the runner transform is unknown.
rows.oracle_evidence: .only is deliberately the input under test (corroborating lines 14-31 and 98-107). The focus helper registers through ordinary originalTest and sets a flag checked by the test. No runtime suite exclusion was demonstrated.

rows.finding_message: Tautological assertion in 'custom element remove event handler': assertion will always pass vacuously.
rows.recommendation: Keep; recommend comparing the saved reference with a fresh DOM lookup and retaining the separate event-count checks.
rows.oracle_evidence: The comment says to verify the second render reused the element (lines 329-339). Comparing the saved reference with itself cannot detect replacement.

rows.finding_message: Snapshot-only test in 'fails if act is called without assertConsoleLogDev': every assertion is a snapshot matcher.
rows.recommendation: Consult unambiguous local helper evidence before asserting every assertion is a snapshot matcher.
rows.oracle_evidence: The local helper first asserts that an error was caught (corroborating lines 325-333 and 378-393). The inline snapshot then checks its diagnostic, including intended user-visible text.

rows.finding_message: Existence-only assertions in 'before_agent_start guards missing event and missing systemPrompt (#439, #440)': test only asserts presence or truthiness without checking values.
rows.recommendation: Distinguish a bare truthiness assertion from explicit required/forbidden substring comparisons.
rows.oracle_evidence: assert.ok(prompt.includes(expected)) and the negated forbidden-substring check (lines 93-97) distinguish wrong content at the same truthiness. These are payload checks.

rows.finding_message: Arbitrary sleep/setTimeout fragility in 'expired links are 410': setTimeout called with delay '1200' in test.
rows.mechanism_note: real wait, but no flakiness established
rows.recommendation: Suggest a controllable clock where available; do not describe it as an unsupported React-flakiness diagnosis.
rows.oracle_evidence: A real 1.2-second sleep for a one-second TTL in a reference fixture (lines 83-86). It costs time; waiting longer does not falsify expiration.

rows.finding_message: Self-mock assertion in 'should not recompute if computed does not track reactive data': test asserts on a mock it created and directly invoked itself.
rows.recommendation: Preserve the span-aware attribution correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: The system under test invokes the callback (corroborating lines 1016-1023). Two computed-value reads with one observed call test caching; the test does not directly invoke its spy.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'rejects reserved file flag %i'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Preserve the optional-return-type correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: An awaited typed helper checks the rejection reason, nested offset and field after corrupting the input (lines 64-80).

rows.finding_message: Tautological assertion in 'does not mutate the input': assertion will always pass vacuously.
rows.recommendation: Keep; recommend comparing against an independent pre-call copy.
rows.oracle_evidence: After shuffleArray(unshuff), both sides refer to the same post-call array (lines 313-315). A mutation would pass.

rows.finding_message: Hard wait in E2E test 'should not appear if FSD review module is completed': waitForTimeout sleeps for a fixed time; wait for a UI condition instead (Playwright: await expect(locator).toBeVisible(); Flutter: pumpUntilFound / pumpAndSettle with a finder).
rows.mechanism_note: fixed wait is the only sync
rows.recommendation: Recommend waiting for the submission/navigation outcome that makes modal eligibility final; simply deleting the wait risks passing before a late modal.
rows.oracle_evidence: One second is the only synchronization before a negative assertion (lines 327-333).

rows.finding_message: Skipped test: 'test.skip(' disables a test; delete it or track the reason in a ticket.
rows.mechanism_note: disabled coverage is real; rationale documented
rows.recommendation: Track the coverage gap; do not blindly enable or delete the test.
rows.oracle_evidence: The test is disabled and the preceding comment explains the missing qualifying page (lines 14-28). Evidence supports tracking the gap.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'v-on inline statement'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Report uncertainty for compile-only regression cases instead of claiming no verification.
rows.oracle_evidence: The regression case links an issue, says "should not error", and compiles the triggering template (lines 154-165). A compiler throw fails the test.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'testFactoryZipExtraction'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Preserve the expression-body helper correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: The expression-bodied test calls a helper (corroborating lines 84-109 and 113-116) that checks classified type, file existence, byte length and SHA-256.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'testInternalApiMarking'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Resolve an inherited base-class test/doTest body before claiming zero assertions; do not whitelist by name.
rows.oracle_evidence: Inherited doTest runs a validator (see compiler/psi/psi-api/testFixtures/org/jetbrains/kotlin/AbstractAnalysisApiCodebaseTest.kt:35,279 and AbstractAnalysisApiInternalApiTest.kt:81-95 for the file assertion on violations).

rows.finding_message: Skipped test: '@Disabled' disables a test; delete it or track the reason in a ticket.
rows.recommendation: Distinguish an abstract class annotation from a concrete method/class; do not report the following concrete test as disabled.
rows.oracle_evidence: The annotation belongs to an abstract class (lines 26-35), with explicit intent to run concrete subclasses. It is not evidence that the following concrete test case was disabled.

rows.finding_message: Tautological assertion in 'testInaccessibleClassSnapshotImplEquals': assertion will always pass vacuously.
rows.recommendation: Recommend a distinct implementation of the interface to discriminate the intended contract; avoid asserting the backend always passes.
rows.oracle_evidence: The operands are identical. ClassSnapshotImpl.kt:23-26 overrides equals with a type predicate. "Will always pass" is stronger than source inspection establishes about the assertion backend.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'testDnsOverHttps'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Resolve an unambiguous same-file Kotlin extension with an asserting body before claiming zero assertions.
rows.oracle_evidence: Both requests call the same-file extension OkHttpClient.get (corroborating lines 760-761 and 1101-1107), which executes each request and asserts response.code == 200.

rows.finding_message: Structural repetition: 'ipv6WithoutPortUses443' shares normalized token structure with 3 other tests in this file (first seen at 'hysteria2WithoutPortUses443', line 11). Note: structural similarity does not prove semantic redundancy.
rows.recommendation: Keep as informational; do not delete either test on shape alone.
rows.oracle_evidence: Bracketed IPv6 and DNS hostname exercise distinct parsing boundaries (partner at line 11; corroborating lines 11-15 and 50-54). Both should default to 443.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'forwardedSignalRejectsHostOnlySignal'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Preserve the closure-form #expect correction that removed this finding; do not re-emit.
rows.oracle_evidence: The closure-form `#expect ... throws:` verifies both the error type and the .invalidArgument code (lines 58-65).

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'totalAtLimitIsAccepted'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.mechanism_note: no explicit matcher but a real boundary oracle
rows.recommendation: Report the uncertainty for a throwing parse at the exact maximum; do not classify the absence of an inline matcher as no verification.
rows.oracle_evidence: Throwing parse must succeed at the maximum (lines 44-51); the adjacent test expects failure one over the maximum. These are complementary boundary oracles.

rows.finding_message: Duplicate test body: 'description' has identical execution tokens to 'spinner' (line 23).
rows.recommendation: Keep the duplicate-test-body finding.
rows.oracle_evidence: Same suite, description "Task", construction, draw() call and exact expected spinner string as the partner at line 23 (corroborating lines 23-30 and 158-165). The second name does not introduce another input.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'testThatCacheResponseCacherCanBeCreatedStaticallyFromProtocol'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Report the uncertainty for a compile-time conformance assertion; do not require a runtime matcher.
rows.oracle_evidence: Passing .cache to a parameter of existential type `any CachedResponseHandler` is the advertised compile-time check (lines 218-230). A runtime matcher is not required to test whether the expression type-checks.

rows.finding_message: Duplicate test body: 'testThatDataTaskProducesValue' has identical execution tokens to 'testThatDataTaskSerializesDecodable' (line 88).
rows.recommendation: Keep the duplicate-test-body finding.
rows.oracle_evidence: Same test class, session/request, decodable type, awaited .value and XCTAssertNotNil as the partner at line 88 (corroborating lines 88-97 and 132-141). The pair exercises the same path.

rows.finding_message: Zero assertions found in test 'testFunc'. Tests without outcome verification give false confidence.
rows.recommendation: Do not classify an unattributed top-level Swift compiler-input function merely by its test prefix; keep a real Swift Testing free `@Test` visible.
rows.oracle_evidence: func testFunc() {} is compiler input. The harness oracle is diff/FileCheck in RUN: directives (lines 1-24). The free function is neither an XCTest method nor an attributed Swift Testing test.
